code_actions.rationale: Admitting H&P lists ARDS on the problem list and early ABG/ventilator data meet ARDS oxygenation thresholds; J80 should be POA=Y (was billed POA=N).
Nephrology consult and discharge summary document contrast-induced AKI with recovery; the chart does not document chronic diabetic CKD attributable to E11.22.

Discharge/transfer documentation shows the patient on low-flow nasal cannula and tolerating trach collar at transfer; dependence on respirator is not active at discharge and is not supported as an active status code.
No provider documentation of cerebral edema found; serial notes document recovery of mental status (A&Ox3, CAM-ICU negative) and discharge without cerebral edema.

Nursing and discharge documentation document a split-thickness skin graft (STSG) rather than a full-thickness autologous tissue substitute; 0HRJX73 (full-thickness autologous replacement) is unsupported.
Problem list documents post-operative anemia requiring transfusion but no documentation specifically supports platelet transfusion; insufficient evidence for PCS 30280B1.

discharge_disposition: 63 - Discharged/transferred to a Medicare-certified long-term care hospital (LTCH)

evidence.quote: Impression Necrotizing fasciitis of the right thigh with gas in the fascial planes.
Extensive necrosis of skin, subcutaneous tissue, and superficial fascia identified. Debridement performed to viable tissue with removal of necrotic tissue.
Found by family obtunded and tachypneic; septic shock and severe DKA identified in the field.
Principal Diagnosis DKA; necrotizing fasciitis of right thigh; septic shock
6 Acute respiratory failure with ARDS - resolved
Assessment AKI multifactorial from DKA, sepsis, and iodinated contrast exposure. Creatinine peak 2.4; urine output maintained with resuscitation.
Split-thickness skin graft placement; foam bolster in place.

Continue prolonged ventilator-liberation protocol (progressive trach-collar trials, nocturnal rest as needed), aggressive mobility and rehabilitation, enteral nutrition, glycemic control, VTE and skin-integrity prophylaxis, and infection surveillance.

system_note: Summary of audit and cited evidence (document / section / page): - What was billed: Principal diagnosis M72.6 (Necrotizing fasciitis) is billed in position 1; the claim also lists R65.21 (severe sepsis with septic shock), J80 (ARDS POA=N), Z99.11 (dependence on respirator POA=N), G93.6 (cerebral edema POA=N), and E11.22 (T2DM with CKD) among other diagnoses. Procedures billed include emergent debridement codes and a full-thickness autologous skin replacement code 0HRJX73 (full thickness) and platelet transfusion 30280B1. Key determinations and reasoning with evidence: 1) Principal diagnosis sequencing error - position 1 should be E11.10 (DKA), not M72.6 (necrotizing fasciitis). - The facility's own inpatient problem/principal-diagnosis header lists DKA first: Principal Diagnosis DKA; necrotizing fasciitis of right thigh; septic shock (INPATIENT MEDICAL RECORD, p.1) (NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n1). Ev: ev5 - The admitting H&P and assessment document severe diabetic ketoacidosis as the presenting problem complicated by necrotizing fasciitis and septic shock: Assessment - 35-year-old ... severe diabetic ketoacidosis (pH 6.98) complicated by necrotizing fasciitis ... septic shock (History & Physical, p.541). Ev: ev4 Therefore the documentation shows DKA occasioned admission and should be sequenced as principal (E11.10). Keeping M72.6 as a secondary diagnosis is appropriate given the operative and imaging confirmation below. 2) Necrotizing fasciitis (M72.6) is supported clinically (but should be secondary, not principal). - CT right thigh: Impression: Necrotizing fasciitis of the right thigh with gas in the fascial planes (Diagnostic Imaging Report - CT Right Thigh with IV Contrast, p.421). Ev: ev1 - Operative report: Extensive necrosis of skin, subcutaneous tissue, and superficial fascia identified; debridement performed to viable tissue with removal of necrotic tissue (Procedure Note - Emergent Surgical Debridement - Right Thigh, p.41). Ev: ev2 These satisfy the policy validation criteria (operative confirmation) for M72.6 (MCC) but do not change the sequencing decision above. 3) Severe sepsis with septic shock (R65.21, MCC) is supported and appropriately coded as an MCC, present on admission (POA=Y). - ED and admitting documentation record septic shock on presentation and vasopressor use: "Found by family obtunded and tachypneic; septic shock and severe DKA identified in the field" (Emergency Department Provider Note, p.541) and the H&P explicitly describes septic shock (NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n8; NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n9). Ev: ev3, ev4 - Early ICU flowsheets/ABG and lactate are consistent with shock (Critical Care Progress Note shows lactate 4.9 and P/F 63). Ev: ev10 The R65.21 assignment (MCC) is supported by provider documentation of septic shock and objective data (vasopressor use and elevated lactate). Note: the facility did not sequence an A40/A41 organism-specific sepsis code as principal; the record does identify organisms (see ID consult) - this sequencing/organism-specific-code choice is discussed below but does not negate R65.21 support. 4) Acute respiratory distress syndrome (J80) - POA flag incorrect on the claim (billed POA=N). Admission H&P documents ARDS as an active problem on admission and early ABG/ventilator data meet ARDS oxygenation thresholds. - Admission problem list includes: "6 | Acute respiratory failure with ARDS - resolved" in the admitting H&P (History & Physical, p.541), i.e., provider documentation at admission supports ARDS present on admission. Ev: ev6 - Early ABG/ventilator data show severe hypoxemia / P/F ratio 63 (Critical Care Progress Note, 05-18, ABG 02:00 with PaO2 60; P/F 63) supporting ARDS physiology (Critical Care Progress Note, p.84). Ev: ev10 - Radiology / consult notes document ARDS during the encounter (Nephrology note: Chest Radiograph, Portable AP: Bilateral opacities compatible with ARDS). Ev: ev11 Conclusion: the record contains provider documentation of ARDS at/near admission plus objective oxygenation data; J80 should be POA=Y rather than POA=N. 5) Unsupported / incorrectly coded diagnoses removed: - E11.22 (Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic chronic kidney disease) - remove: nephrology and discharge documentation describe contrast-induced AKI with recovery and do not document chronic diabetic CKD. "AKI multifactorial from DKA, sepsis, and iodinated contrast exposure. Creatinine peak 2.4; urine output maintained with resuscitation" (Nephrology Consultation, p.779). Ev: ev7; Discharge notes list "contrast-induced AKI with recovery" (Discharge / Transfer Summary, p.845). Ev: ev8 - G93.6 (Cerebral edema) - remove: there is no provider documentation of cerebral edema; serial progress notes document neurologic recovery (Neuro at transfer: A&Ox3, CAM-ICU negative, strength improving) inconsistent with a diagnosis of cerebral edema (Critical Care Progress Note, 06-11, p.494). Ev: ev12 Rationale: Neither the consulting notes nor discharge summary document cerebral edema as a diagnosed complication; the record instead documents recovery of mental status. 6) Unsupported / miscoded procedures removed: - 0HRJX73 (Replacement of right upper leg skin with autologous tissue substitute, full thickness) - remove: the chart documents a split-thickness skin graft (STSG), not a full-thickness autologous tissue substitute. Nursing progress note documents: "Split-thickness skin graft placement; foam bolster in place." (Nursing Progress Note - Day Shift, p.345). Ev: ev9; Discharge summary describes "split-thickness skin graft on ICU day 18" (Discharge / Transfer Summary, p.845). Ev: ev8 - 30280B1 (Transfusion of nonautologous platelets into central vein, open approach) - remove: the record documents post-operative anemia requiring transfusion but provides no explicit documentation of platelet transfusion; the problem list states "Post-operative anemia requiring transfusion" (History & Physical - Active Problem List, p.541) without specifying platelets (NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n9). Ev: ev13 Rationale: The nursing and discharge documentation specifically describe an STSG (split-thickness) rather than a full-thickness autologous-skin replacement PCS code; billed full-thickness code (0HRJX73) is therefore unsupported. For the platelet transfusion PCS (30280B1), the record documents a transfusion for anemia but does not document platelet transfusion - insufficient support for this specific PCS. 7) Ventilator status code (Z99.11) removed: discharge documentation documents the patient on low-flow nasal cannula and tolerating trach collar at transfer (Discharge/Transfer Summary: "Airway/Support: conventional nasal cannula, ambulatory" and transfer instructions to LTAC), i.e., dependence on respirator does not persist at discharge and is therefore not appropriate to remain coded. Ev: ev8 Bottom line corrective actions (claim-level): - Sequence change: make E11.10 (Type 2 diabetes mellitus with ketoacidosis) principal (position 1) per the admitting documentation (H&P and facility principal-diagnosis header). Ev: ev5, ev4 - Keep M72.6 (necrotizing fasciitis) as secondary (supported by CT and operative notes). Ev: ev1, ev2 - Keep R65.21 (severe sepsis with septic shock, MCC) (supported by ED/H&P documentation of septic shock and vasopressor use). Ev: ev3, ev4 - Change J80 POA indicator from N to Y (supported by admitting H&P and early ABG/P/F). Ev: ev6, ev10 - Remove E11.22 (diabetic CKD) and G93.6 (cerebral edema) for lack of supporting documentation. Ev: ev7, ev8, ev12 - Remove 0HRJX73 (full-thickness autologous skin replacement) and 30280B1 (platelet transfusion) as the chart documents split-thickness skin graft and an unspecified transfusion for anemia rather than platelet transfusion. Ev: ev9, ev8, ev13 All citations above are to: NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf sections and pages as indicated next to each evidence id (ev1..ev13). Principal diagnosis: the review proposed E11.10 in place of the billed M72.6. Nothing in the record contradicts M72.6 independently, so it is kept as the principal and E11.10 as a secondary diagnosis; a reviewer should confirm the principal.
rationale_letter: To: Medical Records/Coding Department Re: MR_13 - DRG coding determination and required corrections Dear Provider/Coder, An audit of the inpatient stay MR_13 (admit 05/18/2026) was performed comparing billed diagnoses/procedures to the medical record and governing DRG coding policy. Based on the chart documentation and applicable policy, the audit identified the following Findings requiring correction: 1) Principal diagnosis sequencing error (Finding): The admitting documentation and facility problem list identify severe diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) as the condition that occasioned admission. Specifically, the inpatient header lists "Principal Diagnosis DKA; necrotizing fasciitis of right thigh; septic shock" and the admitting H&P documents "severe diabetic ketoacidosis (pH 6.98) complicated by necrotizing fasciitis ... with septic shock" (History & Physical, 05/18/2026; Inpatient Record header). Therefore E11.10 (Type 2 diabetes mellitus with ketoacidosis) should be the principal diagnosis (position 1) on the claim rather than M72.6. Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n1 (Inpatient record header) and NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n9 (H&P, 05/18/2026). 2) Necrotizing fasciitis (M72.6) is supported but should be coded as a secondary diagnosis: CT imaging documents gas in the fascial planes and the operative debridement note documents gross fascial necrosis and debridement to viable tissue (CT Right Thigh, 05/18/2026; Procedure Note - Emergent Surgical Debridement, 05/18/2026). Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n13; NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n16. 3) Severe sepsis with septic shock (R65.21, MCC) is supported and appropriately carries MCC: the ED and admitting notes state septic shock on presentation and document vasopressor support and elevated lactate. Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n8; NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n9. 4) ARDS POA indicator is incorrect: Admission documentation includes "Acute respiratory failure with ARDS" on the admitting problem list, and early ABG/ventilator data meet ARDS oxygenation thresholds (P/F 63). J80 should be POA=Y. Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n9; NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n11; NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n43. 5) Unsupported diagnoses removed: - E11.22 (T2DM with diabetic chronic kidney disease): nephrology consultation documents AKI due to DKA/sepsis/contrast with recovery; the record does not support chronic diabetic CKD. Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n43; NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n1118. - G93.6 (Cerebral edema): no provider documentation of cerebral edema was found; serial notes document neurologic recovery (A&Ox3, CAM-ICU negative) inconsistent with a diagnosis of cerebral edema. Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n165; NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n1118. 6) Unsupported/incorrect procedure codes removed: - 0HRJX73 (full-thickness autologous skin replacement): the record documents split-thickness skin graft placement (nursing note and discharge summary). The billed full-thickness autologous tissue substitute PCS is not supported. Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n125; NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n1118. - 30280B1 (platelet transfusion): the problem list documents post-operative anemia requiring transfusion but the record contains no documentation of platelet transfusion specifically; insufficient evidence to support this procedure code. Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-1-15-MR_13.pdf-n9. Correction being made to the claim (summary): - Principal diagnosis changed to E11.10 (Type 2 diabetes mellitus with ketoacidosis) (position 1). - M72.6 retained as secondary (supported by CT and operative findings). - J80 POA flag changed to Y. - Remove E11.22 and G93.6 for lack of documentation. - Remove PCS 0HRJX73 and 30280B1 due to lack of specific supporting documentation for those exact PCS descriptors. If you disagree with these corrections, please provide targeted clinical documentation within 30 days that supports: (a) why necrotizing fasciitis, rather than DKA, occasioned the admission (if you believe M72.6 should remain principal), (b) documentation of cerebral edema (if G93.6 is to be retained), (c) documentation of chronic diabetic CKD (if E11.22 is to be retained), (d) operative/procedure documentation explicitly supporting full-thickness autologous skin replacement (0HRJX73) or platelet transfusion (30280B1). Absent contemporaneous provider documentation meeting the cited validation criteria, the above corrections will stand. Sincerely, Clinical Audit Team
